content: jiant supports over 50 tasks. Task types include classification, regression, sequence generation, tagging, and span prediction. jiant focuses on NLU tasks like MNLI BIBREF24, CommonsenseQA BIBREF8, the Winograd Schema Challenge BIBREF25, and SQuAD BIBREF26. A full inventory of tasks and task variants is available in the jiant/tasks module.
